KKR & Co. has agreed to sell Infinity Transportation, a full-service railcar and intermodal equipment lessor, to Ares Infrastructure Equity and Ares Insurance Solutions funds for an enterprise value of approximately $2.9 billion.

Founded in 2004, Infinity owns and manages approximately 50,000 railcars, leased to more than 350 unique lessees across the United States, Canada and Mexico.

“Infinity’s railcar portfolio is a critical component of the U.S. transportation and logistics supply chain, and we are pleased to build on our expanding activity in the sector through this transaction,” said Mike Roth, partner in Ares Infrastructure Equity, and Anup Agarwal, head and CIO of Ares Insurance Solutions. “Transportation and logistics assets continue benefiting from the reshoring of manufacturing, increased investment in domestic industrial capacity and growing need for more resilient supply chains. p: KKR & Co.는 종합 서비스 철도 차량 및 복합운송 장비 임대업체인 Infinity Transportation을 Ares Infrastructure Equity 및 Ares Insurance Solutions 펀드에 약 29억 달러의 기업 가치에 매각하기로 합의했다.
2004년에 설립된 Infinity는 약 50,000대의 철도 차량을 소유 및 관리하며 미국, 캐나다 및 멕시코 전역에서 350명 이상의 고유 임차인에게 임대되었다.
